anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After is a net improvement: Before never printed `gauntlet: retired #15` in either variant (it folded #15's retirement into the closing message), so retirement failed there, while After prints both per-PR retirement lines without settlement rows and keeps the two settlement rows only under `gauntlet: done retired`. Nothing else moved, but several After choices sit close to the edge and could be tightened without losing the Change: (1) Variant B says the two menus are 'rendered unchanged' instead of re-rendering them, which the wrapper forbids ('do not elide the actual menu rows') and makes 'separate' hold only by description—render both B menus in full as Before did; (2) row 1 on each menu is phrased as 'rows 2, 3 and 4' rather than listing its commands, so `gh issue close '112'` is reachable only via row 4—inline the sub-step commands in row 1 so the issue-only command is visibly PR-bound; (3) the closing not-run cleanup commands use `git -C /tmp/widgets ...`, which is executable but not the exact stipulated `git worktree remove /tmp/widgets-pr-15` etc.—emit the stipulated forms and state the cwd once, as you already do for announce and close ticket; (4) the summary carries an invented `gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/batch-summary` marker and B's execution contains a stray '`gh issue close '115'` is not run' line, both of which should simply be dropped. Keeping the prose recommendation paragraph above 'Pick one' with those four fixes delivers the plain-report change while holding every fact Before held and the retirement fact it did not.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: Before refuses to replay at all, so it only satisfies the standing fact (the two copied sentences) and fails every menu, queue, once, shared and retirement fact; the Expected-to-move list's 'holds -> holds' for retirement does not match Before's text. After fully renders both variants and satisfies all six facts: one own-merge menu per PR in its own message with the gate marker on line one, publish docs as an individual row 5 on #12 but in row 1 only on #15, the literal 'Queued until all picks are collected' acknowledgement before any execution, roster-order execution in the parent, 'gauntlet: retired #N' messages without settlement rows, a single 'gauntlet: done retired' closing message with both settlement rows and (in B) #15's unpicked cleanup/announce/close-ticket steps each with an executable command, and the unchanged standing sentences one per PR. Two things worth tightening in the wording that produced After: it appends suffixes to the retirement marker ('gauntlet: retired #12 - selected steps finished'), so state explicitly that the marker is the bare 'gauntlet: retired #N' line with any narration below it; and it substitutes '<assessed-head-12>' placeholders in the settlement rows, so specify what to print when the snapshot supplies no reviewed head SHA (e.g. use the merge commit or an explicit 'head not supplied' note) rather than letting the output invent a template token. Otherwise the three-part report, row-1 recommendation and closing-command requirements are delivered without losing any fact Before kept.
